name: Mini Pancake, Sausage & Strawberry Breakfast Skewers with Maple Syrup (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add sausage patties in a single layer. Cook, flipping once halfway, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from heat and cut in half.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and halve strawberries lengthwise. Set aside.
Place pancakes on a microwave-safe plate. Place plate in the microwave and heat on high until warmed through, about 1 minute (or cook according to package instructions).
Thread pancakes, sausage patty halves, and strawberries onto the skewers, alternating ingredients.
Divide skewers between plates. Serve with maple syrup on the side for dipping and enjoy!
